metadata.description: Engineering rules and work item tooling for Claude Code.

plugins.name: rules
plugins.description: Project-independent engineering rules: commit message spec (Conventional Commits, English), commit structure, proceeding and reporting, security, solution design, plan hardening, surgical changes, goals and verification. Rules load at session start; a PreToolUse gate rejects commit messages that break the spec.

plugins.name: workitem
plugins.description: Generates paste-ready content for an issue tracker: a work item definition before the work and a result note after it (task, test, incident or meeting templates). Tracker-independent, writes nothing anywhere, and asks which language the output should be in.
